assessments.summary: The report establishes exact product additivity of the averaged separately-relaxed UV scalar functional by chain-rule decomposition, concave-envelope bounds, and product posterior ensembles. Receiver-skew symmetrization proves equality of the branchwise and averaged functionals and extends this equality and additivity to finite receiver-skew products. Using the declared reference’s sharp global support inequality for the half-skew BSSC gives the exact one-letter value, hence n(2h_2(1/4)-5/4) bits for every finite power.
scopeQualifications: The theorem concerns only the two separately-relaxed scalar UV functionals.
It does not establish tensorization of the full UV region, a common joint-(U,V) optimization, the GK functional, or broadcast-channel capacity.
The objective script corroborates finite identities and numerical values but does not itself verify the continuum support inequality or universal product theorem.
A minor README decimal typo does not affect the exact formula.
